terminal_name: (country sweep note — Republic of the Congo)
issue: 2026-07 discovery re-run after the June Trident-Congo miss corrections. All three prior finds are now in GEM: Congo FLNG (Tango, operating), Eni Congo FLNG II (Nguya, operating — first cargo celebrated 2026-02-07 per Eni), Nkossa FLNG (Trident, proposed). Wing Wah's Banga Kayo LNG (June-staged as a new export terminal, not applied) is demoted to the monitor list: the domestic-vs-seaborne-export scope question is unresolved (see republic-of-the-congo.disc.monitor.json). No third Eni FLNG is planned for Congo (the third-FLNG reports concern Argentina LNG). Upstream-operator sweep (Eni, TotalEnergies/Moho, Perenco Congo, Trident, Wing Wah, SNPC) surfaced no further LNG candidates; the pending national Gas Code remains the forward signal. gem.wiki coverage cross-check clean; note the reverse gap: Nkossa FLNG has a CSV row but no gem.wiki page yet (wiki-lag, not a discovery issue).
suggested_action: Reviewer decision on Banga Kayo: if GEM wants domestic-plus-regional-truck LNG plants excluded, leave on monitor until seaborne-export evidence appears; the June-staged new_terminal record in _archive_pre20260702 can be revived as-is once scope is confirmed.
